run_free_viewpoint_rendering: run free_viewpoint_rendering to render non-rigid NeRF scenes from a trained experiment folder with custom camera paths
run_setup_nonrigid_nerf_network: run _setup_nonrigid_nerf_network to load a trained NeRF model and return rendering functions and helpers
run_render_convenient: run render_convenient to render images from camera poses with optional ray bending latents and motion factors
run_load_llff_dataset: run load_llff_dataset to load LLFF dataset images, poses, and train/test splits for NeRF rendering
run_convert_disparity_to_jet: run convert_disparity_to_jet to convert a disparity map into a colorized jet colormap image for visualization
